about.title: 15 years on fence crews showed us what goes wrong
text: AYMS Fence started after 15 years working as a fence installation crew across the Houston area, where we saw how many homeowners got burned by crews that vanished, quotes that ballooned and materials that weren't as promised.

Every project gets a written quote before work starts, and what you're quoted is what you pay unless you change the scope. We ask only a small deposit to schedule, with the balance due after the work is complete and you've inspected it.

The crew that quotes your job is the crew that builds it, and we answer the phone after the contract is signed. We know Houston's humidity and heavy rain seasons, and we build with materials to match.
